full_bank_scope: all 440 immutable v7 items; 220 concept cues and 220 lesson connections
review_method: Read the immutable v7 questions, every option, explanations in ko/ja/en, all writing samples and rubrics, all 98 audio scripts, all 220 multilingual cues and all lesson connections afresh. Target-language question bodies and options intentionally remain identical across UI languages; instruction triples were read separately.
Recorded independently selected zero-based choice indices before comparing the complete answer set with the bundle. Individual reasons derive from semantic reading, not structural validator approval.

Considered alternative answers, grammatical attachments, distractor plausibility, supplied versus inferred facts, grade-appropriate instruction, distinct situations for each concept, writing length, translation fidelity, and whether rubric requirements exceed the actual prompt.

Read all 86 frozen source records and 220 concept-evidence links. Dictionary metadata and owned public identities are evidence within the frozen bundle, not a new live source acquisition or an official examination-level certification.
Recomputed the draft payload hash and raw source/inventory hashes at start and finish. Did not read other reviewers, author revisions, or inherit earlier approvals.

counterexamples.reason: A justified five-sentence preference for paper-only or app-only guidance satisfies the task without a hybrid design, supplementary condition, or follow-up survey; the rubric explicitly accepts this.
A qualitative stopping condition such as inability to guarantee appeals meets the requested stopping criterion; the rubric does not demand a numerical threshold or assistive-only design.

A six-sentence critique distinguishing reports from actual crime and explaining one justified evidence limit can satisfy the task without proposing a comparison design or listing every omitted variable.

counterexamples.example: 온라인 상태 시간이 35% 늘었다는 사실은 생산성이 같은 비율로 향상됐다는 뜻이 아니다. 접속 시간이 길어도 산출물의 양이나 질이 높아졌다고 단정할 수 없다. 퇴사자를 제외한 결과는 전체 근로자의 경험을 대표하지 못할 수 있다. 다만 퇴사 이유가 제시되지 않아 편향의 방향이나 크기까지 확정할 수는 없다. 따라서 이 자료가 직접 보여 주는 것은 분석 대상자의 온라인 시간 변화이다. 회사의 생산성 향상 주장은 현재 제시된 근거만으로 충분히 뒷받침되지 않는다.
counterexamples.reason: This six-sentence critique addresses proxy validity, possible exclusion bias, and the supported claim without proposing further data, comparison design, or group-equity analysis. The v7 instructions and rubric explicitly leave these additions optional.

limitations: No browser, actual screen, Chrome voice availability, family/device testing, or listening playback was performed; audio review was script-semantic only.
No remote source reacquisition, production/Preview verification, file-backed database write, staging, build, or full test suite was performed.
pnpm ops:status remained non-passing: 38 passed, 2 warnings, 1 failure from a stale file catalog; dirty-worktree and known HEAD/release manifest-drift warnings are outside this semantic artifact.
